name: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
description: Established in 2009, King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) is a graduate research university devoted to finding solutions for pressing scientific and technological challenges in food and health, water, energy, environment and the digital domain. Official materials describe a curiosity-driven, interdisciplinary environment with state-of-the-art labs, distinguished faculty and students from more than 120 nationalities.
